v1.scope: host scheduling, interval/arithmetic, order and abstract ownership only

v2.scope: synthetic counts/jobs, dequantization/submission order, source-owner and callback state only

not_proven: C++/SYCL execution, tensor numerics, actual router IDs/slot map, allocation/context registration, queue/DMA retirement, fault recovery, physical 262144 fit/correctness, RESTORE, or performance

source_findings.feasibility: Keep T/operator chunks at 8192 and group only consecutive GPU-bank spans; the 16-bit helpers accept dynamic row counts, and the design's 997820928-byte typed reservation is arithmetically below the stated 1180698624-byte region. This is source/design feasibility, not runtime fit.
source_findings.current_boundary: run_layer_major sets one layer at a time then calls run_impl; run_impl remains chunk-outer with attention and MoE/HC work coupled per piece. The contract needs an explicit shared split at that boundary; widening m.T would violate existing carve, state, and 8K helper assumptions.
source_findings.owners: m.R16/gated scratch remains 8K; m.emb aliases PLE storage until the final PLE/token consumer, then may hold window FP16 mixed rows and later BF16 BO. Typed injection/route/down views and host source must stay live through both writes and checked retirement.
source_findings.callbacks: Current nonfinal on_chunk16 copies each output into the row bank and drains; passing an already-written bank slice back through it risks a self-copy. Add an internal ordered completion path for intermediate slices, and only expand final slices into FP32 m.R before existing callbacks/MTP can reuse m.region.
source_findings.kernels: native16::write is an in-place BF16 residual update with FP32 injection; combine requires down_rows=rows*10. gather_rows16 checks row count but not the full source extent, so validate every source index against the window. The optional vllm GEMM adapter is selected only when compiled/configured; <=8192 jobs fit its documented 16-bit rectangle limits, with no speed claim.

required_corrections_before_cpp_patch: Name the shared per-piece attention and per-window FFN helpers and pass original tokens, request-relative row/count, absolute position, layer/state ordinal, and explicit residual/typed views; preserve sequential PLE, GDN/QSA state updates exactly once.

Specify direct row-bank in-place FFN writes plus a cursor-only intermediate completion; keep both BO/injection slices live until both writes are checked, then release MoE views before final callback/MTP reuse of m.region.

Extend the host/C++ contract to build actual logical route IDs, expert offsets, source-row lists, slot map and combine destinations; current v2 covers synthetic counts and job totals but no per-token ID-to-slot permutation or numerical combine.
Check actual m.region_bytes, device/context registration, view alignment/extent and all input-bank row bounds before submission; keep old fields and short/decode-layout route intact.

Keep the new path out of periodic server checkpoint use until a producer and RESTORE prove all layer and MTP state corresponds to the same requested prefix; preserve that feature and its existing unresolved state explicitly.

next_main_boundary.scope: One bounded long-prefill C++ change: only a 2-piece GPU-resident MoE window around existing 8K attention helpers, with 8K jobs and 8K fallback for host/boundary/unpaired pieces; no short-path/threshold/decode change.
checks: Build and focused checks for biased ne==W, routing-map conservation/slot order, GPU/host boundary, partial tail, nonzero position, PLE history, GDN/QSA state once-only behavior, and the two final callback slices.
Exercise enqueue/cancel/failure and checked drain with every host/device/typed-view owner retained; verify actual allocation/context spans and m.emb alias deaths.
Use SGLang/vLLM numerical contract for state/routes/outputs and RESTORE, then full physical 262144 context correctness before a separate performance/adoption decision.
next_main_boundary.checkpoint_gate: For periodic checkpoint consumers, keep the existing qualified route or refuse this new route until same-prefix all-layer plus MTP state and RESTORE are verified; do not substitute end-of-run snapshots.
next_main_boundary.new_research: none; Main implementation and validation are the next work, with no novel eligible research question found

retrieval.trigger: Main implementation of the long-prefill 16K MoE window, especially row-bank callback, route-map, or checkpoint integration
